understood_as: User approved ten new Dual adaptation branches from the five normal pretrained full states; preserve 4096 updates and collector slots, not equal valid samples. Force initial waits outside all learning and do not extend budgets.

training_delay.distribution: Uniform integer, per worker at initial branch and every world reset only.
training_delay.independence: Separate delay RNG from kernel, actor, goal sampler and teacher RNG; paired seeds use common delay streams across q.
training_delay.implementation: Commit zero to eight real kernel NOOP transitions before the next actor observation. No actor or teacher call, optimizer or BatchRenorm update for these transitions. World horizon remains 64 including wait.
training_delay.padding: Preserve original command-inactive padding after delivery until world reset. Collector slots include that padding but exclude initial forced waits. Every slot commits a real kernel step. Example: eight waits, success after eight controlled actions, then 48 masked padding steps: 64 physical transitions, 56 collector slots, eight valid samples. A 64-slot rollout can span multiple worlds.
training_delay.accounting: Log collector slots, initial forced wait transitions, their sum as physical environment transitions, valid learner samples, actual PPO and teacher optimizer steps, BatchRenorm counters, episode and valid-sample fixed fractions.

evaluation.rng: Mode is one argmax episode per layout; sample is eight sampled-action episodes. Seeds: mode 60000+1000*learner_seed+layout; sample 61000+1000*learner_seed+64*layout+repeat. Identical streams across condition/delay; forced waits do not consume actor RNG.
evaluation.delay_application: Evaluation starts from original natural fixture state, applies exactly the named deterministic initial NOOP count, and does not draw a training delay. Episode ends on delivery or absolute tick 64.
evaluation.one_shot_block: Trigger on first action whose mutant transition would cross a wall. Select the fixed collision transition computed from that same pre-state, committing dynamics once; thereafter use mutant. Overall success denominator is all episodes; retry/departure conditional summaries use episodes actually blocked. Also record trigger counts and no-trigger success.
evaluation.primary: Final mode, five paired learner seeds, separate delay-specific mutant success/wall pass/control length and fixed success, same-policy kernel return differences; no endpoint selection.
evaluation.secondary: Sample and checkpoint curves; whole-episode discounted return and post-wait control length; triggered vs untriggered one-shot block, repeats, lateral departure and full mode paths.
evaluation.interpretation: 10/12 are departure-time extrapolation on the same transformed fixture, not new-map generalization. Time remains observed. No claim of memory or time-independent inference from success alone.

schedule: Inherit unchanged Dual config from normal pretraining: global update 512 to 4608, original PPO/teacher optimizers and BC schedule. No extra optimizer updates for waits.
baseline: For each seed132..136: q0 source_root/adaptation/mutant_adapt_seed_{seed}/checkpoints/adapt_4096; q.1 /raid/ext_csv/HackRL/runs/spatial_wall_pass_reliability_mix_v1/fixed_10pct_seed_{seed}/checkpoints/adapt_4096. Frozen evaluation only, same grid, no retraining; preserve source hashes and original delay0 raw episode parity.

smoke.purpose: Zero-delay full-state equivalence, finite updates, exact checkpoint resume, counter and optimizer checks; discarded diagnostic states only.
